title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Matthew 25: the ten virgins and their lamps, the servants entrusted with talents, and the sheep separated from the goats.

questions.text: How many of the ten virgins were foolish?
questions.explanation: Of the ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom, five were foolish and five were wise.

answers.text: Two
Three
Five
Seven

questions.text: What did the foolish virgins fail to take with them?
questions.explanation: The foolish ones took their lamps but took no oil with them, while the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

answers.text: Oil
Bread
A second lamp
A cloak for the night

questions.text: At what time was there a cry that the bridegroom was coming?
questions.explanation: While the bridegroom delayed they all slumbered and slept, but at midnight there was a cry that the bridegroom was coming.

answers.text: At evening
At midnight
At the third hour
At daybreak

questions.text: What happened while the foolish virgins went away to buy oil?
questions.explanation: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

answers.text: The other virgins waited for them
Their lamps were filled by the wise
The bridegroom turned back
The bridegroom came and the door was shut

questions.text: How did the man divide his goods among his own servants before his journey?
questions.explanation: He gave five talents to one, two to another, and one to another, to each according to his own ability.

answers.text: Five talents to one, two to another, and one to another
Ten talents to each of the three servants
One talent to each of the three servants
All of his goods to the eldest servant

questions.text: What did the servant who received the one talent do with it?
questions.explanation: He who received the one talent went away, dug in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

answers.text: He traded with it in the city
He gave it to his fellow servants
He dug in the earth and hid his lord's money
He deposited it with the bankers

questions.text: What did the lord say to the servant who brought him another five talents?
questions.explanation: His lord called him a good and faithful servant, said he had been faithful over a few things and would be set over many, and told him to enter into the joy of his lord.

answers.text: That he should keep the talents for himself
That he should go on a longer journey
That he would be given the household to sell
That he should enter into the joy of his lord

questions.text: What reason did the servant with one talent give for hiding it?
questions.explanation: He said he knew his lord to be a hard man who reaped where he did not sow, and that he was afraid, so he hid the talent in the earth.

answers.text: That he had lost the other servants' money
That he was afraid of his lord
That the journey had been far too long
That the bankers would not take it

questions.text: How will the Son of Man separate the nations gathered before him?
questions.explanation: He will separate them one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats, setting the sheep on his right hand and the goats on the left.

answers.text: As a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats
As a farmer separates wheat from chaff
As a fisherman sorts good fish from bad
As a builder sets stone upon stone

questions.text: Why does the King welcome those on his right hand?
questions.explanation: The King answers them that because they did it to one of the least of these his brothers, they did it to him.

answers.text: Because they kept all the commandments
Because they did it to one of the least of these
Because they waited for him until midnight
Because they doubled what he entrusted to them
